posts.title: Should Engineering Leaders Still Code?
posts.description: Should I still be coding as an engineering manager, director, VP, or CTO? This is one of the questions I’ve been asked most often throughout my journey in engineering leadership. It surfaces in day-to-day conversations, coaching sessions, and discussions with other engineering leaders. My answer has always been the same: Yes, but not in the critical path. It’s an interesting debate, especially now

posts.title: Why AI hasn't changed everything (yet)
posts.description: Lately, I’ve been thinking a lot about what it actually means to write software in this new era. Not the tools themselves, we’re all already talking about those, but the habits and assumptions we keep carrying forward without questioning them.

posts.title: New theme for the blog
posts.description: I have been thinking of designing a new blog for myself. It’s one of those things that I used to like, that I have given up. I write a daily journal, but have stopped posting on the blog as often.
